issue_text: Resolve caps the resolved model AND effort against run.MaxShort by looping over `[]string{nn.Model, nn.Effort}` and rejecting an over-length value with reason bad_var. No test ever supplies an over-length effort: the only over-length case (workflow_test.go:431) sets JUDGE (which feeds model) to Repeat("m", MaxShort+1) while JUDGE_EFFORT stays "b". The effort element of the guard is therefore a surviving mutant: change the slice to `[]string{nn.Model}` (drop nn.Effort) and every test in the package still passes, so an over-MaxShort resolved effort string would slip through the early guard and only be caught (if at all) downstream at event-fold time.
why_real: This is a deletable/reducible validation guard with the existing tests still green. The effort half of the MaxShort length check is entirely unpinned — no test exercises an over-length JUDGE_EFFORT / effort value, so removing nn.Effort from the checked slice is undetectable. It is a genuine blind spot in the resolve-time length invariant, not a restatement of intended behavior.
tests_checked: workflow_test.go TestW3Resolve line 431 (only JUDGE/model over-length; JUDGE_EFFORT='b'); grep confirmed no other JUDGE_EFFORT/effort over-length case; only one _test.go in the package (git ls-files).

issue_text: TestW1Shipped asserts `if sdlc.Nodes["fix"].Exec != "inline" || sdlc.Nodes["fix"].Params["x"] != nil`. The sdlc-loop `fix` node is declared `{kind: agent-edit}` with no params at all, so `Params` is an empty map and `Params["x"]` is always nil; the `Params["x"] != nil` disjunct is tautologically false and can never contribute to a failure. The key "x" is arbitrary and set by nothing in the workflow or the code, making this sub-assertion vacuous.
why_real: It is a tautological test clause (category: assertion that cannot fail). If the intent was to assert the fix node carries no params, the correct property is len(Params)==0; checking one arbitrary absent key proves nothing and would not catch a stray param under any other name.
tests_checked: workflow_test.go:118 (the assertion itself); confirmed sdlc-loop.yaml:20 declares fix as `{kind: agent-edit}` with no params, so parseNodes leaves Params an empty map.
